### `preview_owner_roadmap_change` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Validates up to 20 direct owner roadmap operations (create/update items, create dependencies and allocations, update roadmaps and capabilities) and stores a 15-minute preview with a digest; changes no roadmap data.
Use when: The owner explicitly authorized a direct (non-reviewed) roadmap change, typically through a roadmap-owner-advisor/operator agent credential; Validating several item/roadmap/capability edits together before commit_owner_roadmap_change    Avoid when: Ordinary roadmap changes in a governed workspace: use preview_workspace_roadmap_change + submit_workspace_roadmap_change (GOV-MAX); Archive/restore, lifecycle or capability links: not supported here; use the governed flow; Creating one item without owner bypass: use create_workspace_roadmap_item
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Must match the agent credential's workspace |
| rationale | yes | user | 10-2000 chars; commit must repeat it exactly |
| operations | yes | user/agent-built | 1-20 items. { type:'update_item', itemId (list_workspace_roadmap_items -> id), expectedVersion (-> updatedAt), patch{ title?<=300, description?<=5000, category?<=200, priority? urgent\|high\|medium\|low\|none } } \| { type:'create_item', roadmapId (list_workspace_roadmaps -> id), values{ title (required, <=300), description?, category?, priority? (default none) } } \| { type:'create_dependency', roadmapId, sourceItemId, targetItemId, relationship? depends_on\|blocks\|relates_to (default depends_on) } \| { type:'create_allocation', roadmapId, itemId, projectId (list_workspace_projects -> id), role? primary\|contributor\|dependent\|observer (default contributor) } \| { type:'update_roadmap', roadmapId, expectedVersion (list_workspace_roadmaps -> updatedAt), patch{ title?, description? } } \| { type:'update_capability', capabilityId (list_workspace_capabilities -> id), expectedVersion (-> updatedAt), patch{ name?, description? } } |
Preconditions: Caller can read the workspace (commit later needs owner/admin); Items in update_item are not archived; target roadmap not archived; All expectedVersion values are current; API key or agent credential (not exposed to OAuth connectors)
Returns: { id (previewId), digest (previewDigest), operations[] (with entityId for created entities and recorded versions), affectedEntityIds, rationale, expiresAt (15 min), accountableOwnerUserId, actorPrincipalId, credentialId, createdAt }
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Owner roadmap preview requires a rationale between 10 and 2000 characters | Fix rationale length |
| Owner roadmap change requires between 1 and 20 operations | Split into several previews |
| <type> requires ... / patch is empty or invalid / Unsupported owner roadmap operation | Fix the operation shape (see inputs) |
| Owner roadmap item version conflict / Owner roadmap version conflict / Owner capability version conflict | Re-read the entity's updatedAt and preview again |
| Owner roadmap item is unavailable / Owner roadmap is unavailable | Entity missing or archived; check ids |
| Owner dependency items must exist in the selected roadmap / would create a cycle | Use items of the same roadmapId and a non-cyclic target |
| Owner allocation item must exist in the selected roadmap / project is outside the workspace / already exists | Fix roadmapId/projectId or drop the duplicate |
Gotchas:
- Each call creates a new previewId and digest (only a preview record is stored).
- Texts are silently truncated to their limits; an invalid priority is silently dropped and an invalid relationship/role is silently replaced by the default.
- The preview expires in 15 minutes and must be committed with the same credential/principal.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmap_items`, `commit_owner_roadmap_change`

### `commit_owner_roadmap_change` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: idempotencyKey supported
Purpose: Atomically applies an unexpired owner preview exactly as previewed, without any change-request review, and writes an audit event.
Use when: The owner saw this exact preview (operations and rationale) and explicitly told you to commit it    Avoid when: No explicit owner approval: use preview_workspace_roadmap_change + submit_workspace_roadmap_change; The preview is older than 15 minutes: run preview_owner_roadmap_change again
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Same workspace as the preview |
| previewId | yes | preview_owner_roadmap_change -> id |  |
| previewDigest | yes | preview_owner_roadmap_change -> digest |  |
| idempotencyKey | yes | constant (new unique key) | 12-160 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:-] |
| rationale | yes | preview_owner_roadmap_change -> rationale | Must be exactly the preview's rationale |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin; Same agent credential/principal that made the preview; Preview not expired and every recorded version still current; Explicit owner approval of this preview; API key or agent credential with access profile including it (e.g. roadmap-owner-operator); not exposed to OAuth connectors
Returns: { commitId, previewId, previewDigest, affectedEntityIds, committedAt }; idempotentReplay: true on a retry with the same key
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Owner roadmap commit requires a valid idempotencyKey | Use 12-160 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:-] |
| Owner roadmap change preview not found | Check previewId |
| Owner roadmap preview is invalid, changed, or expired | Run preview_owner_roadmap_change again and get owner approval again |
| Owner roadmap preview credential mismatch / principal mismatch | Commit with the same credential that made the preview |
| Owner roadmap commit rationale must match the preview | Pass the preview's rationale verbatim |
| Owner roadmap commit idempotency collision | That key was used for another preview; use a new key |
| ... version conflict / already exists / scope or item version conflict | Something changed since the preview: preview again |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only owner/admin; tell the user |
Gotchas:
- Bypasses change-request review and is NOT blocked by enforce mode: never use it without explicit owner approval.
- Unlike governed allocate, it does not enforce a single primary allocation per item.
- Dependency cycles are checked only at preview time.
- A preview can effectively be committed once.
Pairs with: `preview_owner_roadmap_change`, `get_workspace_roadmap_overview`

| When | Fix |

| Roadmap item not found | Re-read list_workspace_roadmap_items and use an existing id. |

| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap (connectors get JSON-RPC -32003 'The requested operation or resource is not authorized.') | Only the workspace owner or an owner/admin member may do this. Stop and ask the workspace owner; do not retry. |

- Bypasses change-request review even though it is exposed to connectors under roadmap:manage; under GOV-MAX use it only on explicit owner instruction.

### `archive_workspace_roadmap` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent

Use when: The workspace owner decided a roadmap is superseded or abandoned and asked to archive it    Avoid when: Archive individual items -> preview_workspace_roadmap_change with changeType archive (or archive_workspace_roadmap_item when the owner asks for a direct change); Just stop using it as the active roadmap -> update_workspace_roadmap with status draft

|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID of the workspace. |
| roadmapId | yes | list_workspace_roadmaps -> id |  |
| reason | yes | user | Non-empty rationale; stored as archiveReason. |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member with role owner/admin (check get_workspace -> ownerId and list_workspace_members -> role); Roadmap header exists; The workspace owner explicitly instructed this direct change (GOV-MAX: roadmap changes are otherwise proposed via change requests)
Returns: Header JSON with status 'archived', archivedAt, archivedBy, archiveReason, updatedAt.

| When | Fix |
|---|---|

| Roadmap item archive requires a reason. / Roadmap item restore requires a reason. | Pass a non-empty reason. |

Pairs with: `preview_workspace_roadmap_item_bulk`, `list_workspace_roadmap_items`
CLI: `lpm roadmap item-bulk-commit --workspace <workspaceId> --item-ids <id; id> --operation <update|archive|restore> --confirm [--roadmap <roadmapId>] [--title <text>] [--description <text>] [--category <text>] [--priority <urgent|high|medium|low|none>] [--reason <text>] [--json]`

| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: this workspace roadmap runs in enforce mode... | Do not retry. Propose the change with preview_workspace_roadmap_change then submit_workspace_roadmap_change (changeType edit, prioritize, archive, restore, link...) and let a reviewer approve it. |
| Roadmap dependency cannot point to the same item. | Use two different item IDs. |
| Both roadmap dependency items must exist in the selected roadmap. | Check both items' roadmapId in list_workspace_roadmap_items; cross-roadmap dependencies are not possible here. |
| Active roadmap dependency already exists. | Nothing to do; treat as done (also what a retry after success returns). |
| Roadmap dependency would create a cycle. | Inspect get_workspace_roadmap_overview with includeArchived:true -> itemLinks (archived/rejected links count too) and report the cycle to the owner; do not force it. |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap (connectors get JSON-RPC -32003 'The requested operation or resource is not authorized.') | Only the workspace owner or an owner/admin member may do this. Stop and ask the workspace owner; do not retry. |
| Tool not listed / JSON-RPC -32003 on a ChatGPT or Claude connector | This tool has no OAuth scope; it only works over an API-key MCP connection. Tell the user; call get_mcp_connection_info to confirm. |
Gotchas:
- The cycle check counts every link stored in that roadmap, including archived and rejected ones and every type (even relates_to), so it can refuse a valid link; the governed link path ignores archived links.
- Archived items are accepted as endpoints. Writes an audit event.
- API-key MCP only (no OAuth scope, so ChatGPT/Claude connectors never see it).
Pairs with: `get_workspace`, `list_workspace_roadmap_items`, `list_workspace_roadmap_item_links`, `update_workspace_roadmap_dependency`
CLI: `lpm roadmap dependency-create --workspace <workspaceId> --roadmap <roadmapId> --source-item <itemId> --target-item <itemId> [--type <depends_on|blocks|relates_to>] [--rationale <text>] [--json]`

### `update_workspace_roadmap_dependency` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Directly changes a roadmap dependency link's type, rationale or status (active, rejected, archived), without review.
Use when: Governance mode is shadow or off AND the workspace owner explicitly asked to reject a dependency (status rejected) or fix its type/rationale    Avoid when: Archive with a recorded reason -> archive_workspace_roadmap_dependency; Create a new link -> preview_workspace_roadmap_change (changeType link) or create_workspace_roadmap_dependency; Enforce mode -> blocked and there is no governed unlink change type; report to the owner (changing the mode is the owner's decision)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID of the workspace. |
| linkId | yes | list_workspace_roadmap_item_links -> id (or create_workspace_roadmap_dependency -> id; archived/rejected links only via get_workspace_roadmap_overview includeArchived:true -> itemLinks[].id) | Roadmap dependency link ID. |
| type | no | constant | blocks \| depends_on \| relates_to \| shared_capability \| enables_future_use. Not validated by the server. |
| rationale | no | user | Replaces the rationale; empty string clears it. |
| status | no | constant | active \| rejected \| archived. Not validated by the server. |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member with role owner/admin (check get_workspace -> ownerId and list_workspace_members -> role); Roadmap governance mode is not 'enforce' (get_workspace -> roadmapGovernanceMode; missing means 'shadow', 'off' if roadmapGovernanceEnabled is false); Link exists; At least one of type, rationale, status is passed; The workspace owner explicitly instructed this direct change (GOV-MAX: roadmap changes are otherwise proposed via change requests)
Returns: Merged link JSON (previous fields + patch) with updatedAt and updatedBy.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: this workspace roadmap runs in enforce mode... | Do not retry. Propose the change with preview_workspace_roadmap_change then submit_workspace_roadmap_change (changeType edit, prioritize, archive, restore, link...) and let a reviewer approve it. |
| Roadmap dependency not found | Re-read list_workspace_roadmap_item_links (or the overview with includeArchived:true) and use an existing id. |
| Roadmap dependency update has no changes. | Pass at least one of type, rationale, status. |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap (connectors get JSON-RPC -32003 'The requested operation or resource is not authorized.') | Only the workspace owner or an owner/admin member may do this. Stop and ask the workspace owner; do not retry. |
| Tool not listed / JSON-RPC -32003 on a ChatGPT or Claude connector | This tool has no OAuth scope; it only works over an API-key MCP connection. Tell the user; call get_mcp_connection_info to confirm. |
Gotchas:
- Reactivating (status active) skips the duplicate and cycle checks, so it can create a cycle or a duplicate: check list_workspace_roadmap_item_links first.
- status archived here records no reason; prefer archive_workspace_roadmap_dependency. Writes an audit event.
- API-key MCP only (no OAuth scope, so ChatGPT/Claude connectors never see it).
Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmap_item_links`, `get_workspace_roadmap_overview`
CLI: `lpm roadmap dependency-update --workspace <workspaceId> --link <linkId> [--type <depends_on|blocks|relates_to>] [--rationale <text>] [--status <active|rejected|archived>] [--json]`

### `archive_workspace_roadmap_dependency` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Directly archives a roadmap dependency link, storing the reason (no review).

| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID of the workspace. |
| linkId | yes | list_workspace_roadmap_item_links -> id (or create_workspace_roadmap_dependency -> id; archived/rejected links only via get_workspace_roadmap_overview includeArchived:true -> itemLinks[].id) | Roadmap dependency link ID. |
| reason | yes | user | Non-empty. It overwrites the link's rationale. |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member with role owner/admin (check get_workspace -> ownerId and list_workspace_members -> role); Roadmap governance mode is not 'enforce' (get_workspace -> roadmapGovernanceMode; missing means 'shadow', 'off' if roadmapGovernanceEnabled is false); Link exists; The workspace owner explicitly instructed this direct change (GOV-MAX: roadmap changes are otherwise proposed via change requests)
Returns: Link JSON with status 'archived', rationale = the reason, updatedAt, updatedBy.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Roadmap dependency archive requires a reason. | Pass a non-empty reason. |
| GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: this workspace roadmap runs in enforce mode... | Do not retry. Propose the change with preview_workspace_roadmap_change then submit_workspace_roadmap_change (changeType edit, prioritize, archive, restore, link...) and let a reviewer approve it. |
| Roadmap dependency not found | Re-read list_workspace_roadmap_item_links and use an existing id. |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap (connectors get JSON-RPC -32003 'The requested operation or resource is not authorized.') | Only the workspace owner or an owner/admin member may do this. Stop and ask the workspace owner; do not retry. |
| Tool not listed / JSON-RPC -32003 on a ChatGPT or Claude connector | This tool has no OAuth scope; it only works over an API-key MCP connection. Tell the user; call get_mcp_connection_info to confirm. |
Gotchas:
- The reason REPLACES the original rationale (which survives only in the audit event); archivedAt/archivedBy/archiveReason fields are not set.
- Archived links still count in create_workspace_roadmap_dependency's cycle check.
- Undo: update_workspace_roadmap_dependency with status active.
- API-key MCP only (no OAuth scope, so ChatGPT/Claude connectors never see it).

### `resolve_workspace_roadmap_dependencies` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, planning, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Finds dependency references in imported roadmap items (the depends-on column) and, when confirmed, creates the selected depends_on links.
Use when: Right after commit_workspace_roadmap_import, to turn the dependency column into item links; Listing unresolved dependency references and cycles in a roadmap (preview, read-only, safe)    Avoid when: Adding one manual dependency -> create_workspace_roadmap_dependency; Viewing existing links -> list_workspace_roadmap_item_links; Workspace roadmap in enforce mode -> submit_workspace_roadmap_change with changeType 'link'
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| roadmapId | yes | commit_workspace_roadmap_import -> roadmapId or list_workspace_roadmaps -> id |  |
| confirmed | no | constant | Omit/false = read-only preview; true = create links |
| selectedDependencyKeys | no | built from preview candidates[] | Required when confirmed=true. Each key = '<sourceItemId>:<targetItemId>:depends_on' |
Preconditions: Preview: caller is a workspace member; Commit: caller is the workspace owner or admin; Commit: preview returned cycles = [] and the owner approved the selected links
Returns: candidates[] (sourceItemId, targetItemId, type 'depends_on', rationale), unresolved[] (sourceItemId, reference), cycles[] (lists of item ids); after a commit also createdLinkIds[].
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Cannot commit roadmap dependencies while cycles are present | Show the cycles to the owner. Any cycle blocks the whole commit, even for keys outside it; fix the references in the items or create the correct links one by one with create_workspace_roadmap_dependency. |
| Roadmap dependency commit requires selectedDependencyKeys. | Build keys '<sourceItemId>:<targetItemId>:depends_on' from the preview candidates the owner approved. |
| access_denied: You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only owner/admin can commit; the preview still works for members. Ask the owner. |
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Confirm workspaceId with list_workspaces. |
Gotchas:
- Authority per mode: without confirmed (or confirmed:false) it is a read-only preview that any reader may run ([A]); confirmed=true writes and needs the owner's order for this exact commit ([O]).
- Without confirmed=true it is a read-only preview you may run freely.
- The result has no key field: build each key yourself.
- Only items imported from TSV with a dependency column produce candidates; references match the source id column or the exact title (case/accents ignored).
- Existing links are skipped, so retries are safe.
- The cycle check covers only the candidates, not links created manually.
- Commit does not check enforce mode: only on the owner's instruction.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
Pairs with: `commit_workspace_roadmap_import`, `list_workspace_roadmap_item_links`, `create_workspace_roadmap_dependency`
CLI: `lpm roadmap dependencies --workspace <workspaceId> --roadmap <roadmapId> [--commit --confirm --selected-keys '<key>; <key>'] [--json]`

### `create_workspace_roadmap_allocation` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Assigns a project to a roadmap item as a manual active allocation (default role primary), optionally replacing the item's current primary in the same commit.
Use when: The owner decided which project delivers a roadmap item and asked you to record it; The owner asked to move an item's primary ownership to another project (pass replacesAllocationId); Adding a contributor project to an item that already has a primary    Avoid when: The workspace roadmap is in enforce mode (error GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED) -> preview_workspace_roadmap_change then submit_workspace_roadmap_change with changeType 'allocate'; You only want suggestions to show the owner -> suggest_workspace_roadmap_allocations (preview, no confirmed); Changing role or rationale of an existing allocation -> update_workspace_roadmap_allocation; The owner has not decided the allocation: propose it, do not apply it (GOV-MAX)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| roadmapId | yes | list_workspace_roadmap_items -> roadmapId of the item | Must be the roadmap that contains itemId |
| itemId | yes | list_workspace_roadmap_items -> id |  |
| projectId | yes | list_workspace_projects -> id | Project must belong to the same workspace |
| role | no | constant | primary (default) \| contributor \| dependent \| observer. Server does not validate the value: use only these. observer cannot be materialized |
| rationale | no | user | Why this project; default 'Manual allocation confirmed by workspace owner.' |
| replacesAllocationId | no | list_workspace_roadmap_allocations -> id of the item's current active primary (also printed in the PRIMARY_ALREADY_ASSIGNED error) | Only with role primary; required when the item already has an active primary |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or a workspace admin; Workspace roadmap governance mode is not 'enforce'; Project belongs to the workspace and the caller can read it; Item exists in the given roadmap; The owner explicitly authorized this allocation (GOV-MAX)
Returns: The new allocation: id (allocationId), itemId, projectId, role, status 'active', routingSource 'human_assigned', confidence 1, confirmedAt. When replacing, the old allocation becomes status 'superseded' with supersededBy = new id.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| PRIMARY_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: item ... already has primary allocation <id> (project <projectId>) | If the owner wants to replace it, retry with replacesAllocationId=<that id>. If the new project only helps, retry with role 'contributor'. |
| ALLOCATION_ALREADY_ACTIVE | That project already has this role on the item (common after a retry). Nothing to do; confirm with list_workspace_roadmap_allocations. |
| REPLACED_ALLOCATION_NOT_ACTIVE | replacesAllocationId must be the single active primary of this item. Re-read list_workspace_roadmap_allocations (status active, role primary) and retry with that id, or drop it if the item has no primary. |
| REPLACEMENT_ONLY_FOR_PRIMARY | Remove replacesAllocationId or use role primary. |
| Roadmap allocation project must belong to the roadmap workspace. | Use a projectId from list_workspace_projects for this workspaceId. |
| Roadmap allocation item must exist in the selected roadmap. | Pass the item's own roadmapId (list_workspace_roadmap_items -> roadmapId). |
| GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: this workspace roadmap runs in enforce mode | Do not retry. Propose with preview_workspace_roadmap_change + submit_workspace_roadmap_change, changeType 'allocate', patch { projectId, role?, rationale? }, expectedUpdatedAt = item updatedAt. |
| access_denied: You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only the workspace owner/admin can allocate. Stop and ask the owner. |
| You do not have access to this project | Caller cannot read the project; ask the owner. |
Gotchas:
- At most one active primary per item; replacement is atomic (old one -> superseded).
- The CLI has no flag for replacesAllocationId, so replacing a primary needs the MCP tool.
- Archived items are accepted as targets, so check the item is not archived.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmap_items`, `list_workspace_projects`, `list_workspace_roadmap_allocations`, `preview_roadmap_materialization`
CLI: `lpm roadmap allocation-create --workspace <workspaceId> --roadmap <roadmapId> --item <itemId> --project <projectId> [--role <primary|contributor|dependent|observer>] [--rationale <text>] [--json]`

### `update_workspace_roadmap_allocation` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Changes the role, rationale or status (active, rejected, archived) of an existing roadmap allocation.
Use when: The owner rejected an allocation that was suggested by routing (status rejected); Correcting the rationale or changing a contributor's role on the owner's instruction; The owner asked to reactivate an archived or rejected allocation (status active)    Avoid when: Moving primary ownership to another project -> create_workspace_roadmap_allocation with replacesAllocationId; Archiving with a recorded reason -> archive_workspace_roadmap_allocation; Workspace roadmap in enforce mode -> preview_workspace_roadmap_change + submit_workspace_roadmap_change
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| allocationId | yes | list_workspace_roadmap_allocations -> id |  |
| role | no | constant | primary \| contributor \| dependent \| observer (not validated by the server) |
| rationale | no | user | Empty string clears it |
| status | no | constant | active \| rejected \| archived (not validated by the server) |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or a workspace admin; Workspace roadmap governance mode is not 'enforce'; Allocation exists; At least one of role, rationale, status is given; The owner authorized the change

| When | Fix |
|---|---|

Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmap_allocations`, `suggest_workspace_roadmap_allocations`, `preview_roadmap_materialization`
CLI: `lpm roadmap allocation-update --workspace <workspaceId> --allocation <allocationId> [--role <primary|contributor|dependent|observer>] [--rationale <text>] [--status <active|rejected|archived>] [--json]`

| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| roadmapId | yes | list_workspace_roadmaps -> id |  |
| confirmed | no | constant | Omit/false = read-only preview; true = create allocations |
| selectedAllocationKeys | no | built from preview candidates[] | Required when confirmed=true. Each key = '<itemId>:<projectId>' |
Preconditions: Preview: caller is a workspace member; Commit: caller is the workspace owner or admin and the owner approved each selected allocation

Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Roadmap allocation commit requires selectedAllocationKeys. | Build keys '<itemId>:<projectId>' from the candidates the owner approved. |

- Authority per mode: without confirmed (or confirmed:false) it is a read-only preview that any reader may run ([A]); confirmed=true writes and needs the owner's order for this exact commit ([O]).

- Up to 3 candidates per item; confidence <= 0.49 with rationale 'Weak routing terms only' means no ownership term matched: ask the owner.

### `preview_workspace_roadmap_import` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Parses a tab-separated (TSV) roadmap table and shows the rows that would be imported, without writing anything.
Use when: The user provides a spreadsheet/TSV roadmap to load into LPM: always run this first; Checking which columns were recognized and which rows will be skipped    Avoid when: Creating one or a few items -> create_workspace_roadmap_item; Actually writing the import -> commit_workspace_roadmap_import (only after this preview and the owner's approval)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| content | yes | user | TSV text: first line = headers, columns separated by TAB (not comma). Recognized headers (case/accent-insensitive): title\|titulo\|name\|nome\|funcionalidade (required per row); description\|descricao\|summary\|resumo; category\|categoria\|type\|tipo; capability\|capacidade\|capabilidade; depends on\|dependencias\|depends\|blocks (list separated by ; , or \|); id\|source id\|codigo; status\|situacao; priority\|prioridade (0 or 0.5=urgent, 1=high, 2=medium, 3=low, 4=none, or urgente/alta/media/baixa) |
| sourceRef | no | user | File name or source label; reuse exactly the same value in commit_workspace_roadmap_import |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member
Returns: sourceRef, rowCount, rows[] (rowNumber, title, description, category, capabilityName, dependsOn[], priority, originalId, originalStatus, idempotencyKey, raw), warnings[] (e.g. 'Row N ignored because title is empty.', 'Roadmap import is empty.').
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| rowCount 0 or warning 'Roadmap import is empty.' | Check the content is TAB-separated with a header row that has a title column; convert CSV to TSV and preview again. |
| warnings 'Row N ignored because title is empty.' | Show the skipped rows to the user; fix the title cells if they should be imported. |
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Confirm workspaceId with list_workspaces; ask the owner for access. |
Gotchas:
- Each row's idempotencyKey depends on sourceRef, id, title, category and row number: changing sourceRef or row order changes the keys (and duplicates on commit).
- A 'blocks' column is read as depends_on (the row depends on the referenced item): check the direction with the user.
- Priority defaults to none when unrecognized.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
- The CLI uses the file path as sourceRef when --source-ref is omitted.
- Archived items are not deduplicated: a re-import into the same roadmapId recreates rows whose earlier items were archived. Restore them with restore_workspace_roadmap_item instead of re-importing.
Pairs with: `commit_workspace_roadmap_import`, `resolve_workspace_roadmap_dependencies`
CLI: `lpm roadmap import-preview --workspace <workspaceId> --file <path> [--source-ref <text>] [--json]`

|---|---|
| Roadmap import commit requires confirmed=true | Get the owner's approval of the preview, then send confirmed=true. |
| access_denied: You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only the workspace owner/admin can import. Stop and ask the owner. |
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Confirm workspaceId with list_workspaces. |
Gotchas:
- Without roadmapId every call creates a NEW roadmap, so a retry duplicates everything; on retry pass the roadmapId from the first result.
- With roadmapId, rows whose idempotencyKey already exists in that roadmap are skipped (compare createdItemIds.length with importedRows).
- Empty or invalid content still creates an empty roadmap.
- Dependency columns are NOT linked here: run resolve_workspace_roadmap_dependencies next.
- All writes are one atomic batch.
- It does not check enforce-mode governance, so GOV-MAX applies: run only on the owner's instruction.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
- Archived items are not deduplicated: a re-import into the same roadmapId recreates rows whose earlier items were archived. Restore them with restore_workspace_roadmap_item instead of re-importing.
Pairs with: `preview_workspace_roadmap_import`, `resolve_workspace_roadmap_dependencies`, `suggest_workspace_roadmap_allocations`, `review_workspace_roadmap_item`
CLI: `lpm roadmap import-commit --workspace <workspaceId> --file <path> --confirm [--roadmap <roadmapId>] [--title <text>] [--source-ref <text>] [--json]`

### `review_workspace_roadmap_item` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, planning, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: not idempotent
Purpose: Moves a roadmap item to its next lifecycle gate (reviewed, approved, deferred, rejected, delivered, closed) and records the rationale.
Use when: The owner decided to review, approve, defer or reject an item and asked you to record it; An item must be approved before preview_roadmap_materialization / commit_roadmap_materialization    Avoid when: Workspace roadmap in enforce mode (GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED) -> preview_workspace_roadmap_change + submit_workspace_roadmap_change with changeType 'lifecycle', patch { lifecycle, rationale }; Editing title, description or priority -> update_workspace_roadmap_item; Archiving -> archive_workspace_roadmap_item; The owner has not decided: propose the decision, never approve on your own
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| itemId | yes | list_workspace_roadmap_items -> id | Read its current lifecycle first |
| lifecycle | yes | constant | reviewed \| approved \| deferred \| rejected \| delivered \| closed. Allowed moves: draft or imported -> reviewed/deferred/rejected; reviewed -> approved/deferred/rejected; approved -> deferred; deferred or rejected -> reviewed; materialized -> delivered; delivered -> closed |
| rationale | no | user | The owner's reason for the decision |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or a workspace admin; Workspace roadmap governance mode is not 'enforce'; Item exists and is not archived; The transition is allowed from the item's current lifecycle; The owner made this decision
Returns: id, lifecycle (new value), updatedAt (new item version).
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Invalid roadmap item lifecycle transition from X to Y. | Read the item's lifecycle (list_workspace_roadmap_items) and move one gate at a time (imported -> reviewed -> approved). Repeating the current lifecycle also fails: treat it as already done. |
| Archived roadmap items cannot change lifecycle. Restore the item first. | Ask the owner; restore with restore_workspace_roadmap_item, then review. |
| Roadmap item not found | Get itemId from list_workspace_roadmap_items for this workspace. |
| GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: this workspace roadmap runs in enforce mode | Do not retry. Propose via preview_workspace_roadmap_change + submit_workspace_roadmap_change with changeType 'lifecycle', patch { lifecycle, rationale }, expectedUpdatedAt = item updatedAt. |
| access_denied: You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only owner/admin can move lifecycle gates. Stop and ask the owner. |
Gotchas:
- Approving an imported item takes two calls (reviewed, then approved).
- 'approved' cannot go back to 'reviewed' (only to 'deferred'); 'closed' is final.
- Items materialized with commit_roadmap_materialization keep the stored lifecycle 'approved' (progress is in materializationSummary.state), so 'delivered' then fails with 'Invalid roadmap item lifecycle transition from approved to delivered': report it to the owner, do not try other values.
- The tool does not stop the same person from reviewing and approving.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmap_items`, `get_workspace_roadmap_item_history`, `preview_roadmap_materialization`, `commit_roadmap_materialization`
CLI: `lpm roadmap review --workspace <workspaceId> --item <itemId> --lifecycle <reviewed|approved|deferred|rejected> [--rationale <text>] [--json]`

### `preview_roadmap_materialization` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, read-only, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Shows, without writing, how an approved roadmap item would become a requirement in each allocated project (link an existing requirement or create a new one).
Use when: Always right before commit_roadmap_materialization, to get the candidate and sourceItemVersion; Checking whether a project already has a requirement covering a roadmap item    Avoid when: Viewing lineage already committed -> list_workspace_roadmap_materializations; The item is not approved yet -> review_workspace_roadmap_item (owner's decision) first
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| itemId | yes | list_workspace_roadmap_items -> id |  |
| projectId | no | list_workspace_roadmap_allocations -> projectId | Pass it: then only that project's current baseline is matched and baselineId is filled |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member; Caller can read the allocated projects
Returns: item (its updatedAt is the sourceItemVersion for commit; effectiveGovernanceLifecycle), allocations[], candidates[] (itemId, projectId, method linked_existing|new_requirement|deferred, requirementId, baselineId, confidence, rationale).
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Roadmap item not found | Get itemId from list_workspace_roadmap_items; archived items are not found. |
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Confirm workspaceId with list_workspaces. |
| You do not have access to this project | An allocated project is not readable by the caller; ask the owner. |
Gotchas:
- A candidate with method 'deferred' and rationale 'must be approved' or 'has no confirmed project allocation' means STOP and fix that first; do not commit it.
- Candidates can include superseded or observer allocations, which the commit rejects.
- Each commit changes the item's updatedAt: re-run this preview before materializing the same item for another project.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
Pairs with: `review_workspace_roadmap_item`, `list_requirement_baselines`, `commit_roadmap_materialization`, `list_workspace_roadmap_materializations`
CLI: `lpm roadmap materialize-preview --workspace <workspaceId> --item <itemId> [--project <projectId>] [--json]`

### `commit_roadmap_materialization` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: idempotencyKey supported
Purpose: Records that an approved roadmap item is materialized in one project: links an existing requirement or creates a new pending requirement in the project baseline (no issues), or records a conflict/deferred decision.
Use when: The owner approved materializing an approved roadmap item into a project, right after a fresh preview_roadmap_materialization; Recording a conflict or deferred materialization decision with rationale    Avoid when: No fresh preview -> preview_roadmap_materialization; Item not approved -> review_workspace_roadmap_item (owner's decision); Creating activities/issues -> create_issue (this tool creates none); Already materialized for that project -> list_workspace_roadmap_materializations
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| itemId | yes | preview_roadmap_materialization -> item.id |  |
| projectId | yes | preview_roadmap_materialization -> candidates[].projectId | Needs an active, non-observer allocation for this item |
| method | yes | preview_roadmap_materialization -> candidates[].method | linked_existing \| new_requirement \| split_from_parent \| conflict \| deferred |
| requirementId | no | preview_roadmap_materialization -> candidates[].requirementId or list_requirements -> id | Required for linked_existing; must be empty for conflict |
| baselineId | no | preview_roadmap_materialization -> candidates[].baselineId or list_requirement_baselines -> id | Default: the project's current baseline |
| rationale | no | user | Required for split_from_parent, conflict and deferred |
| confirmed | yes | constant | true, only after the owner approved |
| idempotencyKey | yes | agent-generated | 12-160 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:-], e.g. mat:<itemId>:<projectId>:<yyyymmdd>. Reuse the same key on every retry |
| sourceItemVersion | yes | preview_roadmap_materialization -> item.updatedAt | Copy exactly |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner/admin AND can manage the target project; Item governance lifecycle is approved; Item has an active allocation for the project with a role other than observer; No productive materialization (linked_existing, new_requirement, split_from_parent) exists yet for item+project; Item unchanged since the preview (sourceItemVersion matches); For new_requirement/split_from_parent: the project has a requirement baseline; The owner authorized this materialization
Returns: id (materialization id), requirementId (linked or newly created), baselineId, lineageKey, materializationSummary (eligibleAllocationCount, productiveLineageCount, attentionLineageCount, state unmaterialized|partial|complete|attention); idempotentReplay=true when the key was already completed.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Roadmap materialization commit requires confirmed=true | Get the owner's approval, then send confirmed=true. |
| Roadmap materialization requires a valid idempotencyKey | Use 12-160 characters from [A-Za-z0-9._:-]. |
| Roadmap materialization requires sourceItemVersion from preview | Run preview_roadmap_materialization and pass item.updatedAt. |
| Roadmap item changed after preview; refresh the preview before committing | Run preview_roadmap_materialization again and retry with the new item.updatedAt. |
| Roadmap item must be approved before materialization | The owner must approve it first (review_workspace_roadmap_item: reviewed, then approved). |
| Roadmap item has no active allocation for the target project | Check list_workspace_roadmap_allocations; the owner must allocate the project first (create_workspace_roadmap_allocation). |
| Observer allocations are not eligible for materialization | Pick a project whose allocation role is primary, contributor or dependent. |
| A productive materialization already exists for this item and project | Already done: check list_workspace_roadmap_materializations. If it came from your own earlier attempt, retry with that original idempotencyKey. |
| Target project has no requirement baseline for materialization | Ask the owner to create a baseline (create_requirement_baseline) or use linked_existing with an existing requirement. |
| linked_existing materialization requires requirementId / linked_existing requirement is not available in the target project | Pass a non-deleted requirementId of that project (preview candidate or list_requirements). |
| conflict materialization records lineage without requirementId. | Remove requirementId for method conflict. |
| <method> materialization requires rationale. | Pass the owner's rationale for split_from_parent, conflict or deferred. |
| Roadmap materialization idempotency collision | Use a new idempotencyKey for this new intent. |
| You do not have permission to manage this project / access_denied | Owner/admin of workspace and manager of project required. Stop and ask the owner. |
Gotchas:
- No tool undoes it: the item+project lineage claim is permanent.
- After a timeout or error, retry with the SAME idempotencyKey; a new key can fail with 'A productive materialization already exists'.
- The commit changes the item's updatedAt, so materializing the same item for a second project needs a new preview.
- New requirements get the item's title, type business, status pending; no issues are created.
- The stored item lifecycle stays 'approved'.
- It does not check enforce-mode governance.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
Pairs with: `preview_roadmap_materialization`, `list_workspace_roadmap_materializations`, `list_requirements`, `create_issue`
CLI: `lpm roadmap materialize-commit --workspace <workspaceId> --item <itemId> --project <projectId> --method <linked_existing|new_requirement|split_from_parent|conflict|deferred> --source-item-version <updatedAt> --idempotency-key <key> --confirm [--requirement <requirementId>] [--baseline <baselineId>] [--rationale <text>] [--json]`

### `update_workspace_roadmap_governance_policy` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: idempotencyKey supported
Purpose: Sets the workspace roadmap governance mode (off, shadow or enforce) and the solo material-approval alert threshold.
Use when: The owner explicitly decides to switch the mode (e.g. activate enforce for GOV-MAX) or to change the solo alert threshold    Avoid when: Reading the current mode: use get_workspace -> roadmapGovernanceMode and roadmapGovernancePolicy (missing mode = shadow); Changing roadmap items: use the governed flow (preview_workspace_roadmap_change -> submit_workspace_roadmap_change)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| mode | yes | user (owner decision) | off \| shadow \| enforce |
| expectedUpdatedAt | no | get_workspace -> updatedAt | Workspace version; recommended to avoid overwriting a concurrent change |
| soloMaterialAlertThreshold | no | user (owner decision) | 1-100, default 5; every Nth solo non-routine approval alerts all members |
| idempotencyKey | yes | constant (new unique key per policy change) | Same key replays the earlier result |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin; Explicit owner decision; API key or agent credential (not exposed to OAuth connectors)
Returns: { workspaceId, mode, previousMode, policy{ policyVersion, soloMaterialAlertThreshold, updatedAt, updatedBy }, updatedAt }
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| INVALID_GOVERNANCE_MODE | Use off, shadow or enforce |
| IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED | Pass a non-empty idempotencyKey |
| VERSION_CONFLICT | Re-read get_workspace -> updatedAt and retry |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only owner/admin; tell the user |
Gotchas:
- Omitting soloMaterialAlertThreshold resets it to 5 (it is not preserved): always pass the current value.
- A reused idempotencyKey returns the earlier result even for a different mode: check result.mode.
- enforce makes update_workspace_roadmap_item, archive/restore_workspace_roadmap_item, commit_workspace_roadmap_item_bulk, create/update_workspace_roadmap_dependency, create/update_workspace_roadmap_allocation and review_workspace_roadmap_item fail with GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED; off makes preview/submit fail with ROADMAP_GOVERNANCE_DISABLED.
- enforce does NOT block commit_owner_roadmap_change.
- Not flagged as sensitive, so 'portfolio' API-key profiles can call it.
Pairs with: `get_workspace`, `get_workspace_roadmap_governance_observability`

### `preview_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Dry-run report of the one-off 'roadmap materialization v2' migration for legacy materialized roadmap items; writes nothing.
Use when: The owner explicitly asks whether a workspace still has legacy (pre-v2) materialized roadmap items; Right before apply_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration, to confirm valid=true and mode='migration-required'    Avoid when: Normal materialization work: use preview_roadmap_materialization / commit_roadmap_materialization; Checking the governance-field migration: use preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration (a different migration); Inspecting roadmap state: use get_workspace_roadmap_overview
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active member with role owner/admin; API key with access profile 'full' or 'custom' (sensitive admin tool; not exposed to OAuth connectors)
Returns: { expectedLegacyLineages: 10, legacyItemCount, reconcilableCount, valid, rows[{ itemId, allocationCount, productiveLineageCount, valid }], migratedItemCount, alreadyMigrated, mode: 'no-op' | 'migration-required', computedAt }
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Stop: only the workspace owner/admin can run it. Tell the user. |
| This API key is not allowed to call MCP tool (-32003) | Call get_mcp_connection_info; this tool needs a full/custom API key profile. Ask the owner, do not look for another key. |
Gotchas:
- Hard-coded for exactly 10 legacy lineages (a one-off migration written for one specific workspace): any other count gives valid=false.
- Legacy item = lifecycle 'materialized' and materializationSchemaVersion != 2; a row is valid when every active non-observer allocation project has a productive materialization.
Pairs with: `apply_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration`

### `apply_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, custom · sensitive: yes · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Rewrites the exactly-10 legacy materialized roadmap items and their materializations to the v2 schema and creates productive lineage claims.
Use when: Only when the owner explicitly orders this migration for a named workspace AND preview_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration just returned valid=true and mode='migration-required'    Avoid when: Any routine roadmap task (this is a one-off data migration); Preview returned valid=false or mode='no-op': do not run; report the preview to the owner; Stamping governance fields on items/activities: use apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID |
| idempotencyKey | yes | constant (generate once, e.g. 'roadmap-v2-<workspaceId>-20261005') | 12-160 chars, only letters, digits, '.', '_', ':', '-' |
| confirmed | yes | constant true, only after the owner confirmed | Anything other than boolean true is rejected |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner/admin; API key profile 'full' or 'custom' (sensitive admin tool; not in OAuth connectors); Preview is valid (exactly 10 legacy materialized items, all reconcilable); Explicit owner order
Returns: Preview report fields plus { applied: true, appliedItemIds[], idempotencyKey }; when already migrated { applied: false, idempotentReplay: true, mode: 'no-op' }
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Roadmap v2 migration requires confirmed=true | Get the owner's explicit confirmation, then pass confirmed: true |
| Roadmap v2 migration requires a valid idempotencyKey | Use 12-160 chars of [A-Za-z0-9._:-] |
| Roadmap v2 migration aborted: expected exactly 10 reconcilable lineages, found N | Stop. Report the preview rows to the owner; do not try to fix data yourself |
| aborted on non-reconcilable item X / Roadmap migration item lifecycle changed: X / item disappeared: X | Stop and report to the owner which items were already migrated (re-run the preview) |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Stop: owner/admin only |
Gotchas:
- Not atomic: one transaction per item.
- If it fails midway, the remaining items can no longer be migrated by this tool (the preview then shows fewer than 10 legacy items -> valid=false) and there is no rollback tool.
- Looks like a legacy one-off migration; treat as deprecated.
Pairs with: `preview_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration`, `get_workspace_roadmap_overview`

### `preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` [A] · read · KEY · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Counts the roadmap items that lack governance versioning and the activities that lack a work origin, without writing anything.
Use when: The owner asks how much legacy data the governance migration would touch; Right before apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration    Avoid when: The materialization v2 migration: use preview_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration; Lineage of one item: use get_workspace_roadmap_traceability
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin; API key or agent credential (not exposed to OAuth connectors)
Returns: { workspaceId, roadmapItemsToSnapshot, legacyIssuesToClassify, inferredRoadmapOrigins: 0, policy: 'preserve-history-no-origin-inference' }
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only owner/admin; tell the user |
Gotchas:
- Reads every activity of every project in the workspace.
- legacyIssuesToClassify excludes deleted activities, but the apply also stamps deleted ones, so appliedWrites can be higher.
Pairs with: `apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration`

### `apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` [O] · write · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: idempotencyKey supported
Purpose: Stamps governanceVersion 1 on every roadmap item that lacks it and marks every activity without a work origin as workOrigin 'legacy-unknown' with empty roadmap lineage, recording one migration run.
Use when: The owner explicitly orders the governance migration for a workspace, after reviewing preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration    Avoid when: Changing the governance mode: use update_workspace_roadmap_governance_policy; Linking activities to roadmap items: use preview_roadmap_materialization / commit_roadmap_materialization; Any routine task (bulk write over all activities of the workspace)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| idempotencyKey | yes | constant (e.g. 'gov-migration-<workspaceId>-20261005') | Non-empty; the migration id is derived from it |
| confirmed | yes | constant true, only after the owner confirmed | Falsy -> MIGRATION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin; Explicit owner order; API key or agent credential (not exposed to OAuth connectors)
Returns: { id (migrationId: keep it for rollback), status: 'completed', preview, appliedWrites, inferredRoadmapOrigins: 0, completedAt }; idempotentReplay: true when the same key already completed
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| MIGRATION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED | Get the owner's confirmation and pass confirmed: true |
| IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED | Pass a non-empty idempotencyKey |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only owner/admin; tell the user |
| Call fails midway (timeout or error) | Retry with the SAME idempotencyKey: only records still missing the fields are written, under the same migrationId |
Gotchas:
- Writes in chunks of 400 with no global transaction.
- After a rollback, the same key returns the old completed run and does NOT re-apply: use a new key.
- Never infers roadmap origin.
- Not flagged as a sensitive admin tool, so 'portfolio' API-key profiles can call it.
Pairs with: `preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration`, `rollback_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration`

### `rollback_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` [O] · destructive · KEY · profiles: full, portfolio, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Deletes the fields one governance migration run wrote: governance fields on roadmap items, and workOrigin, roadmapLineageRefs and the run marker on activities.
Use when: The owner explicitly orders undoing a specific governance migration run    Avoid when: Undoing a governed roadmap change: submit an opposite change with submit_workspace_roadmap_change; Turning governance off: use update_workspace_roadmap_governance_policy with mode 'off'
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| migrationId | yes | apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration -> id | Format 'migration_<32 hex>'. Lost it? Call apply again with the same idempotencyKey: the replay returns the id without writing |
| idempotencyKey | yes | constant (new unique key) | Only recorded on the run document |
| confirmed | yes | constant true, only after the owner confirmed | Falsy -> ROLLBACK_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED |
Preconditions: Caller is workspace owner or admin; Explicit owner order; API key or agent credential (not exposed to OAuth connectors)
Returns: { workspaceId, migrationId, rolledBackWrites, status: 'completed' }
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| ROLLBACK_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED | Get the owner's confirmation and pass confirmed: true |
| IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED | Pass a non-empty idempotencyKey |
| rolledBackWrites is 0 | Wrong migrationId or already rolled back; recover the id from apply with the original key |
| You do not have permission to manage this workspace roadmap | Only owner/admin; tell the user |
Gotchas:
- migrationId is not validated (a wrong id silently does nothing and still records a run document).
- It deletes workOrigin AND roadmapLineageRefs from every activity stamped by that run, even if real lineage was added later: lineage data loss.
- Not transactional (chunks of 400).
- Not flagged as sensitive, so 'portfolio' API-key profiles can call it.
Pairs with: `apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration`, `preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration`

## Used here (owned by another skill; rules live there)

### `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-roadmap` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Returns the whole workspace roadmap read model in one call: roadmaps, capabilities, items, capability links, item dependencies, project allocations, materializations, counts and governance counters.
Use when: Start of any roadmap task, to collect IDs and current state in one call; Need items together with their dependencies, allocations, capability links and materializations; Check how many governed change requests are pending (governance.pendingReviewCount); Find archived/rejected dependency links (includeArchived:true)    Avoid when: Only roadmap headers -> list_workspace_roadmaps; Only items -> list_workspace_roadmap_items; Only active dependency links -> list_workspace_roadmap_item_links; Lineage of one item -> get_workspace_roadmap_traceability; Narrative analysis or advice -> analyze_workspace_roadmap
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID. A connector (OAuth) grant bound to a single workspace may omit it. |
| roadmapId | no | list_workspace_roadmaps -> id | Scopes roadmaps, items, links, allocations and materializations to one roadmap. Capabilities stay workspace-wide. |
| includeArchived | no | constant | Boolean, default false. true adds archived roadmaps, capabilities and items plus rejected/archived links and allocations. |
| compact | no | constant | Boolean, default false. true drops item and capability descriptions and source.raw. Use on large workspaces. |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member
Returns: {workspaceId, generatedAt, roadmaps[], capabilities[], items[] (id, roadmapId, title, lifecycle, priority, isArchived, updatedAt...), capabilityLinks[], itemLinks[] (id, sourceItemId, targetItemId, type, status), allocations[] (id, itemId, projectId, role, status), materializations[], counts{byLifecycle, byCapabilityId, byProjectId, materialized}, governance{enabled, pendingReviewCount, staleCount}, compact?}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Use a workspaceId from list_workspaces; the caller must be the owner or an active member of that workspace. |
| Connector: JSON-RPC -32003 insufficient_scope, or the tool is missing from the tool list | Call get_mcp_connection_info; the connection needs the workspace:read scope. |
| Connector: JSON-RPC -32602 'Invalid OAuth tool arguments.' (data.field + data.problem: unknown_field, too_long, invalid_value, invalid_id) | Follow data.hint: drop fields not in the schema, shorten text, use an allowed value or a real document ID, then retry. |
| Connector call fails or is cut off because the response is too large | Retry with compact:true and a roadmapId. |
Gotchas:
- Unpaginated and can be large: prefer compact:true plus roadmapId.
- compact here removes descriptions entirely (list_workspace_roadmap_items compact only truncates to 280 chars).
- governance.enabled does not distinguish shadow from enforce: read get_workspace -> roadmapGovernanceMode.
- Items of an archived roadmap still appear unless the item itself is archived.
- An item's updatedAt is the expectedUpdatedAt that governed change tools require.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `get_workspace`, `preview_workspace_roadmap_change`, `get_workspace_roadmap_traceability`
CLI: `lpm roadmap status --workspace <workspaceId> [--roadmap <roadmapId>] [--include-archived] [--json]`

### `list_workspace_roadmap_items` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-roadmap` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the roadmap items of a workspace, optionally only those of one roadmap.
Use when: Need itemIds, titles, lifecycle, priority or updatedAt (the expectedUpdatedAt of governed changes); Find items to edit, archive, link, allocate or analyze; Check for an item with the same title before creating one    Avoid when: Need dependencies/allocations/capability links too -> get_workspace_roadmap_overview; Change history of one item -> get_workspace_roadmap_item_history; Lineage of one item -> get_workspace_roadmap_traceability
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID. A connector (OAuth) grant bound to a single workspace may omit it. |
| roadmapId | no | list_workspace_roadmaps -> id | Only items of this roadmap. |
| includeArchived | no | constant | Boolean, default false. true includes archived items. |
| compact | no | constant | Boolean. true drops source.raw and cuts descriptions to 280 chars (cut rows carry descriptionTruncated:true). |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member
Returns: JSON array of items {id (itemId), roadmapId, title, description, category, lifecycle, governanceLifecycle, priority, isArchived, archiveReason, materializationSummary, source?, createdAt, updatedAt, updatedBy}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Use a workspaceId from list_workspaces; the caller must be the owner or an active member of that workspace. |
| Connector: JSON-RPC -32003 insufficient_scope, or the tool is missing from the tool list | Call get_mcp_connection_info; the connection needs the workspace:read scope. |
| Connector: JSON-RPC -32602 'Invalid OAuth tool arguments.' (data.field + data.problem: unknown_field, too_long, invalid_value, invalid_id) | Follow data.hint: drop fields not in the schema, shorten text, use an allowed value or a real document ID, then retry. |
| Connector call fails or is cut off because the response is too large | Retry with compact:true and a roadmapId. |
Gotchas:
- The tool description says connectors get compact rows by default, but the server compacts ONLY when compact:true is passed; pass it explicitly on big workspaces. Not paginated.
- Without roadmapId it also returns items whose roadmap header is archived.
- Lifecycle values: draft, imported, reviewed, approved, deferred, rejected, materialized, delivered, closed.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmaps`, `preview_workspace_roadmap_change`, `get_workspace_roadmap_traceability`, `update_workspace_roadmap_item`
CLI: `lpm roadmap status --workspace <workspaceId> [--roadmap <roadmapId>] [--include-archived] --json (read the items field)`

### `list_workspace_roadmap_allocations` [A] · read · KEY · owner `lpm-roadmap` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the project allocations of a workspace roadmap (which project owns or contributes to each roadmap item), optionally filtered by roadmap and project.
Use when: Find which project(s) a roadmap item is allocated to before materializing it or asking the Advisor about it; Get the allocationId needed by update_workspace_roadmap_allocation, archive_workspace_roadmap_allocation or replacesAllocationId of create_workspace_roadmap_allocation; Check whether an item already has an active primary allocation before creating one    Avoid when: You need everything about one project (items, links, lineage, repository context) -> get_project_roadmap_drilldown; You need items, links, allocations and counts together -> get_workspace_roadmap_overview; You want automatic project suggestions for unallocated items -> suggest_workspace_roadmap_allocations
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document id |
| roadmapId | no | list_workspace_roadmaps -> id | Omit to list allocations of all roadmaps in the workspace |
| projectId | no | list_workspace_projects -> id | Filter applied after reading the whole roadmap |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member
Returns: JSON array of allocations: id (allocationId), itemId, projectId, roadmapId, role (primary|contributor|dependent|observer), status (active or superseded; missing status = active), routingSource (human_assigned|hybrid|auto_inferred), rationale, confidence, confirmedBy, confirmedAt, supersededBy.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Caller is not an active member of that workspace. Confirm workspaceId with list_workspaces; if correct, ask the owner for access. |
| JSON-RPC -32003 The requested resource is outside the credential scope | The agent credential is bound to another workspace. Use that credential's workspaceId or ask the owner for a credential for this workspace. |
Gotchas:
- Archived and rejected allocations are hidden, but SUPERSEDED ones are returned: treat only status 'active' (or no status) as current.
- Allocations of archived items are hidden. No pagination.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (ChatGPT/Claude): needs an API key.
- CLI alternative: 'lpm roadmap status --workspace <id> --json' returns the overview including the allocations array.
Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmap_items`, `create_workspace_roadmap_allocation`, `update_workspace_roadmap_allocation`, `archive_workspace_roadmap_allocation`, `preview_roadmap_materialization`

### `list_workspace_roadmap_materializations` [A] · read · KEY · owner `lpm-roadmap` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists materialization lineage records: which roadmap item became which project requirement, or was recorded as conflict/deferred.
Use when: Check whether an item is already materialized for a project before commit_roadmap_materialization; Trace a roadmap item to its requirementId and baselineId; Audit attention lineages (method conflict or deferred) that still need a decision    Avoid when: Full roadmap view of one project -> get_project_roadmap_drilldown; What would be materialized next -> preview_roadmap_materialization; Item-to-activity traceability -> get_workspace_roadmap_traceability
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| roadmapId | no | list_workspace_roadmaps -> id |  |
| projectId | no | list_workspace_projects -> id |  |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member
Returns: JSON array: id, itemId, projectId, roadmapId, method (linked_existing|new_requirement|split_from_parent|conflict|deferred), lineageState (productive|attention), requirementId, baselineId, rationale, idempotencyKey, sourceItemVersion, decidedBy, decidedAt.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Caller is not a member of that workspace. Confirm workspaceId with list_workspaces; ask the owner for access. |
| JSON-RPC -32003 The requested resource is outside the credential scope | Use the workspace the agent credential is bound to. |
Gotchas:
- Productive methods are linked_existing, new_requirement and split_from_parent; only one productive lineage may exist per item+project.
- Records of archived items are hidden.
- Legacy records may lack schemaVersion/lineageState. No pagination.
- Not exposed to OAuth connectors (API key only).
- CLI alternative: 'lpm roadmap status --workspace <id> --json' (materializations array).
Pairs with: `preview_roadmap_materialization`, `commit_roadmap_materialization`, `list_requirements`

### `list_workspace_roadmap_item_links` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-roadmap` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the active dependency/relationship links between roadmap items.
Use when: See what a roadmap item blocks or depends on; Get a linkId before update_workspace_roadmap_dependency or archive_workspace_roadmap_dependency; Check that a link does not already exist before proposing or creating one    Avoid when: Need archived or rejected links -> get_workspace_roadmap_overview with includeArchived:true (itemLinks); Cross-workspace activity links -> list_portfolio_work_item_links; Activity-to-activity links -> list_workspace_issue_links or list_issue_links
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id | Firestore document ID. A connector (OAuth) grant bound to a single workspace may omit it. |
| roadmapId | no | list_workspace_roadmaps -> id | Only links stored under this roadmap. |
Preconditions: Caller is the workspace owner or an active workspace member
Returns: JSON array of {id (linkId), roadmapId, sourceItemId, targetItemId, type (blocks|depends_on|relates_to|shared_capability|enables_future_use), status, rationale, changeRequestId?, createdAt, createdBy, updatedAt}. Read as: sourceItemId <type> targetItemId.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have access to this workspace roadmap | Use a workspaceId from list_workspaces; the caller must be the owner or an active member of that workspace. |
| Connector: JSON-RPC -32003 insufficient_scope, or the tool is missing from the tool list | Call get_mcp_connection_info; the connection needs the workspace:read scope. |
| Connector: JSON-RPC -32602 'Invalid OAuth tool arguments.' (data.field + data.problem: unknown_field, too_long, invalid_value, invalid_id) | Follow data.hint: drop fields not in the schema, shorten text, use an allowed value or a real document ID, then retry. |
Gotchas:
- No includeArchived option: rejected and archived links, and links touching an archived item, are always hidden.
- Builds the full overview internally (same cost as get_workspace_roadmap_overview).
Pairs with: `list_workspace_roadmap_items`, `preview_workspace_roadmap_change`, `update_workspace_roadmap_dependency`
CLI: `lpm roadmap status --workspace <workspaceId> [--roadmap <roadmapId>] --json (read the itemLinks field)`

### `list_workspace_projects` [A] · read · portfolio:read · owner `lpm-start` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the projects of a workspace (archived ones excluded unless requested).
Use when: Finding a projectId inside a known workspace.; Mapping the projects of a workspace before creating cross-project links.    Avoid when: You also want to filter by team or prefer the shared listing used by the CLI ('lpm projects list --workspace-id'): use list_projects.; You need one project's details: use get_project.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
| includeArchived | no | constant | Boolean, default false. |
Preconditions: The caller is the workspace owner or an active member (project-only or team-only access is denied).; OAuth: scope portfolio:read and the workspace in the grant.
Returns: JSON array of full project records {id, name, key, description, workspaceId, teamId, ownerId, archived, ...}. id is the projectId.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32602 'You do not have access to this workspace' | You are not a workspace member; try list_projects (also returns projects you reach via team/ownership) or ask the owner. |
| OAuth -32003 | The workspace is outside the grant; call get_mcp_connection_info. |
Gotchas:
- Returns full project records (can be large), unordered, no pagination.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `get_project`, `list_issues`

### `list_requirement_baselines` [A] · read · portfolio:read · owner `lpm-requirements-scope` · profiles: full, read-only, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists all requirement baselines (approved scope snapshots) of a project, newest first; the one with isCurrent=true is the approved scope.
Use when: You need a baselineId for list_requirements or create_requirement (take the item with isCurrent=true); Checking baseline history and version names before a publication    Avoid when: You need delta counts or publication gate - use get_project_scope_resolution_context (it also returns currentBaseline)
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id) | Firestore project id |
Preconditions: Project exists and the caller can read it
Returns: Array of {id, name, version, description, isCurrent, publishedAt, publishedBy, previousBaselineId, previousBaselineName, publicationNotes, changeSetId, contentFingerprint, requirementCount, createdAt}. Pick isCurrent=true.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Empty array | Wrong projectId or the project has no baseline yet; verify with get_project. The first baseline is published with publish_baseline_from_working_scope on the owner's instruction. |
| -32003 access denied by OAuth policy, or OPERATION_FAILED under an OAuth connector | Call get_mcp_connection_info to check the portfolio:read scope; OAuth hides domain error text, so retry once and then report the projectId you used. |
Gotchas:
- Not paginated.
- If no item has isCurrent=true the project is unbaselined (risk scope:no-current-baseline).
- Each baseline holds its own copies of requirements; never edit requirements of a non-current baseline unless told to.
Pairs with: `list_projects`, `list_requirements`, `create_requirement`, `get_project_scope_resolution_context`

### `list_requirements` [A] · read · portfolio:read · owner `lpm-requirements-scope` · profiles: full, read-only, requirements, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Lists the non-deleted requirements of one baseline with their linked issue/cycle/milestone ids, optionally filtered by group, status or type.
Use when: Reading the approved scope (current baseline) or a past version; Finding a requirementId to update, link or quote; Checking traceability: which requirements have linkedIssueIds    Avoid when: What changed since the baseline - use list_working_scope_delta_entities; Requirements without a baseline - use list_requirements_awaiting_baseline
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| projectId | yes | list_projects -> id (or list_workspace_projects -> id) | Firestore project id |
| baselineId | yes | list_requirement_baselines -> id (the isCurrent one) |  |
| groupId | no | list_requirement_groups -> id |  |
| status | no | constant | pending\|met\|not-met\|in-progress\|obsolete |
| type | no | constant | functional\|non-functional\|interface\|business\|technical |
Preconditions: Project exists and the caller can read it
Returns: Array of {id, title, description, type, status, groupId, baselineId, issueId, linkedIssueIds, linkedCycleIds, linkedMilestoneIds, parentRequirementId, dependencies, sourceDocumentId, previousRequirementId, createdAt, updatedAt}
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| Empty array | Wrong baselineId (or empty baseline); take the isCurrent id from list_requirement_baselines. |
| -32003 access denied by OAuth policy, or OPERATION_FAILED under an OAuth connector | Call get_mcp_connection_info to check the portfolio:read scope; OAuth hides domain error text, so retry once and then report the projectId you used. |
Gotchas:
- Not paginated; results over 1 MB are truncated to {items, truncated:true, returned, total, hint} - filter by groupId/status/type.
- Each published baseline has its own requirement copies with new ids (previousRequirementId points to the older copy); use ids from the current baseline.
Pairs with: `list_requirement_baselines`, `update_requirement`, `list_issues`
CLI: `lpm requirements list --project <projectId> --baseline <baselineId> [--status <status>] [--type <type>] [--group <groupId>] [--json]`

### `get_workspace` [A] · read · workspace:read · owner `lpm-start` · profiles: full, read-only, portfolio, planning, requirements, roadmap-owner-advisor, roadmap-owner-operator, custom · sensitive: no · idempotency: naturally idempotent
Purpose: Returns the stored record of one workspace (name, slug, status, owner, dates).
Use when: Confirming a workspaceId and reading its name and status before acting.    Avoid when: You need a richer summary: use get_workspace_read_model or get_workspace_executive_context.; You need its projects: use list_workspace_projects. Members: list_workspace_members. AI settings: get_workspace_ai_config.
| Param | Req | Source (call → field) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | yes | list_workspaces -> id |  |
Preconditions: The workspace exists.; The caller is the owner or an active member; OAuth: scope workspace:read and the workspace is in the grant.
Returns: {id, name, slug, description, ownerId, status, createdAt, updatedAt, plus any other stored fields}.
Errors → fix:
| When | Fix |
|---|---|
| -32602 'Workspace not found' | Re-read ids with list_workspaces. |
| -32602 'You do not have access to this workspace' | You are not a member. Ask the owner to add you; do not guess another id. |
| OAuth -32003 not authorized | The workspace is outside the connector's grant. Call get_mcp_connection_info. |
Gotchas:
- Raw record: it does not tell your role; use list_workspaces access.canManage for that.
Pairs with: `list_workspaces`, `list_workspace_projects`
